name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
cardText:
Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
Intermediate
1
With plates in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Hinge forward with a flat back.
2
Maintain an overhand grip and internally rotated shoulders.
3
Raise your arms backward toward the ceiling while maintaining a light band in your elbows.

name: Plate Rear Delt Fly
cardText:
Plate Rear Delt Fly
Beginner
1
Keep your back straight and bend forward slightly at the waist.
2
With arms extended, raise the weights out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
3
Pause briefly and then lower the weights back to the starting position.

name: Plate Weighted Inverted Row
cardText:
Plate Weighted Inverted Row
Intermediate
1
Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Place a plate on your chest.
2
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
3
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Weighted Pull Ups
cardText:
Weighted Pull Ups
Advanced
1
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Weight hanging between your legs.
2
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
3
Lower your body back to starting position.
